name: swarm
context: Peer-to-peer agent collectives with no supervisor: agents post to and read from a shared blackboard or message bus and self-organize opportunistically.
tradeoffs: Weakest fit for deterministic SLAs; avoid on critical production paths
avoid_when: The team is small and fixed (use supervisor-worker)
anti_patterns: Agents messaging each other directly, bypassing the board
Pure decentralization without a Lead Agent or quality verification on coordination-heavy tasks
design_principles: All coordination flows through the shared medium
best_practices: Implement multi-layer convergence detection (per-agent stuck detection + global termination)
Emit trace spans per agent per task with swarm_run_id correlation
Set per-agent token budgets to prevent runaway costs
references: OpenAI, Swarm: An Experimental Framework for Multi-Agent Orchestration (GitHub), 2024 — https://github.com/openai/swarm
